text:
jia: Morning team 1 1 Quick one: noticed a pile of unlabeled containers on the middle fridge shelf again. Anyone want to claim the big Tupperware with the green lid? Smells like kimchi. :laughing:
omar: Not mine. But also FYI the small shelf by the sink is getting cluttered with single-serve creamers. Can we consolidate them into a labeled box?
riley: I grabbed the green-lid container last week for takeout, left a note but may have been wiped. Sorry for the kimchi mystery. Ill bring a marker and some labels at lunch.
pantry-bot: Suggestion recorded: "label kit + consolidated creamer box". React with :+1: to approve purchase of permanent labels and a small plastic box.
jia: Thanks Riley! Also can we do a 1x1 'snack roulette' board? People post one-line notes like "cookie: free" or "muffin: please ask" so it's clear at a glance.
sam: Love the roulette board idea. Keeps awkward fridge policing to a minimum. I can make a tiny G-sheet and a printable sign.
ops-bot: Facilities note: cleaned fridge gasket at 10:02. Current fridge temp: 4.20C. If you leave kimchi uncovered again I will summon the smell police. :robot_face:
omar: :laughing: Also small ask  can we stop stacking hot food on the top shelf? Leftover soup made the shelf sweat and ruined a granola bar. If you just wait 10 mins to cool that would help.
riley: Noted. Ill make a sticky: "cool food before fridge" and put near the toaster/fridge combo.
pantry-bot: Quick inventory: crackers x1, granola bars x3, single-serve creamers x8, labeled containers x0. Suggested shop: small label maker, clear plastic box for creamers, mini chalkboard for "snack roulette".
jia: I'll chip in $5 for label maker if ops will reimburse small purchase for shared supplies. Also offering one free banana for whoever starts the snack roulette board. :banana:
sam: Banana accepted. I'll make the sheet and print a sign by 3pm. Also who wants some leftover pad thai? Labelled container on the counter: "sam - take 1"
omar: Take 1 coming up. Thanks! And big yes to the label maker.
ops-bot: Purchase request submitted: label maker + plastic creamer box + mini chalkboard. Ticket #4307. Estimated delivery 3-5 business days.
jia: Solid. Tiny etiquette reminder: if you take the last of something (milk, sugar), please post a note on the fridge that youll replace it. It helps avoid midday meltdowns. :sweat_smile:
riley: Agree. I'll toss a sheet with simple rules: label, cool, replace last item, and "ask before taking named food". Short and sweet.
pantry-bot: Reminder: update shared pantry spreadsheet after purchases: tinyurl.com/pantry-ops. Thanks all!
